title: Alphabets of the Tai Language
author: Rev. Nathan Brown
description: Monumental comparative palaeographical treatise published in the Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal (Vol. 6) at the request of Captain Francis Jenkins, presenting the earliest Western decipherment and phonetic comparative tables of the Ahom, Khamti, Nora (Khamyang), and Shan alphabets.
source: Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal / Internet Archive (biostor-280190)

sentences.notes: Phonological comparison between Ahom and modern Khamti/Shan characters.
